== Usage ==
The license value inserted when a contributor picks '''"Used with explicit permission"''' from the Licensing dropdown on <code>Special:Upload</code>. Automatically adds [[:Category:Files needing licensing review]] since a permission claim is exactly the kind of thing worth a second person double-checking — describe how/from whom permission was obtained in the file description.

The outer notice uses the <code>noexcerpt</code> class so maintenance/editorial
text is excluded from article excerpts and Page Previews.
